Command-line arguments.

The executable takes optional positional arguments that override the config's sources and ignoredPatterns for this run. Each argument is one of:

src/foo.nim a file src/module/* a glob pattern src/foo.nim:10-12 a file, restricted to line ranges

With no arguments the config's sources are used.

Types

Options = object
  targets*: seq[Target]
  format*: string            ## `text` or `github`.
Everything the command line can say. Source   Edit   
Target = object
  path*: string              ## A file or a glob pattern.
  lines*: seq[tuple[first, last: int]] ## Empty means the whole file.

proc parseTarget(arg: string): Target {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}

Splits an argument into a path and optional line ranges.

The split is on the last :, and only when the suffix parses as ranges, so paths containing colons (Windows drive letters) are left alone.
